Dot-Com Crash.rationale: Valuation bubble collapse concentrated in technology and telecom, ending at the Nasdaq bear market trough on October 9, 2002.

2008 GFC Peak.rationale: Systemic banking contagion, credit freeze, and acute equity market liquidation ending at the Q1 2009 broad market trough.

2020 COVID Shock.rationale: Acute lockdown shock, global cross-asset liquidation, and subsequent central bank emergency liquidity interventions.

2022 Rate Tightening.rationale: Macro-monetary discount rate repricing across the full calendar year 2022 Federal Reserve aggressive rate-hiking cycle.
